Layer.CheckForFailCommand: %function(self) if Player1Failed then self:decelerate(0.5) self:diffuse(0.6,0.6,0.6,1) end end
%function(self) if Player1Failed then self:bounceend(0.5) self:zoom(1) self:diffusealpha(1) end end
